text:
Anya: Quick async check — where are we on tracing hooks rollout + dashboard error-analysis views? Need clear owners and any blockers so we can ship core console observability milestones by EOD Friday.
Rahul: I'm wrapping the tracing hooks PR but staging is failing intermittently — spans missing span_id sometimes, looks like agent compat issue. Trying to repro.
Mari: Dashboard side is mostly wired (panels + layout), but need final query to include service_tag and error_type. Pinged @Mathias for the schema change.
Mathias: I'll take the schema mapping change. Will open a migration PR today, ETA: Wed.
Rahul: I'll re-run the staging stack with agent v2.1.4 and see if that fixes the span_id loss. @deploy-bot can you kick a canary once I push?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for staging (canary-2026-03-17-2059). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7642 — looking at agent traces now.
Olivia: Quick note on retention: we initially planned 90 days hot retention for traces but cost ops flagged a spike. Proposal: 60 days hot + 90 days cold archive. Anyone strongly against?
Anya: I prefer a split too — 60 hot, 90 cold archive sounds like a reasonable compromise. @Mari can you add retention config to the rollout checklist and surface any dashboard queries that will break? Also who owns error-alerting (pagerduty route)?
Mari: Yup will add to the checklist and test queries against archived data. I'll wire the alerts to pd-routing-console. Assigning alert-owner to Rahul for instrumentation signals.
Rahul: Ack. I'll add the instrumentation PR + unit tests and request review. Also can someone review PR #1234 (tracing hooks) when it's up? https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1234
Mathias: I'll review #1234 today. Note: this depends on metrics-team adding the latency tag — I've pinged them in #metrics.
Olivia: Cost team confirmed: 60 hot / 90 cold is acceptable if we add an archive pipeline. :thumbsup:
Anya: Action items summary — Mathias: schema + migration PR; Rahul: tracing hooks PR + instrumentation tests + run canary; Mari: dashboard queries + add retention to rollout checklist + wire alerts; Olivia: finalize cost signoff and help with archive pipeline plan. Can we reconvene here with short updates tomorrow (Thursday) AM?
Rahul: ack
Mari: ack
Mathias: ack
Olivia: ack
Anya: Thanks everyone — if any blocker pops up, drop it here and tag owners.
